invariants: System Admin is a separate principal and security realm.
User shared props never contain System authorization.
Admin shared props never contain organization or project workspace data.
User realm contains Personal, Organization Management, and per-project Project Workspace.
Organization Management does not duplicate project execution surfaces.
Project Workspace contains exactly four shared Kanban boards.
System Administration contains one AI dispute progress Kanban board.
Create, detail, inbox, and history behavior use board overlays or filters.

phases.name: Realm isolation
items: Split SystemAuthUser from WorkspaceAuthUser.
Shape shared props by request realm.
Remove isAdmin, canSwitchToAdmin, Admin mode, and /admin/toggle.
Fix SystemAdminContextMiddleware to the System realm.
acceptance: Admin responses exclude workspaceAccess, organizations, and projects.
User responses exclude system_role and system_permissions.

phases.name: Capability-based workspace access
items: Expose Personal, optional Organization Management, and accessible projects.
Restrict ordinary members to stakeholder/member projects.
Clear stale current project.
Use capability-driven switchers.
acceptance: Ordinary organization members do not see every organization project.
Organization Management appears only when canEnterManagement is true.
Admin never appears in the user workspace switcher.

phases.name: Project Workspace
items: Add Project layout/sidebar.
Canonicalize project overview and supporting sections.
Add exactly four board navigation entries.
Open organization portfolio projects in Project Workspace.
Preserve project section while switching project.

phases.name: Board-first project interactions
items: Make Task board the only task list.
Open task create/detail as board modal/card room.
Redirect legacy task create/detail/edit and Organization task-detail URLs into the Project board overlay.
Open task review detail on the Task Review board.
Replace pending inbox with waiting_on_me filter.
Replace reverse-review history with status=done filter.
Render AI and terminal lanes.
acceptance: Done creates or reuses awaiting_review atomically.
Task deep links use task_id on the project board.
Sprint review deep links use workflow_id on the matching project board.
Legacy task page controllers never render a separate create/detail/edit screen.

phases.name: Isolated System Admin board
items: Convert /admin/disputes into a Kanban progress board.
Keep /admin/disputes/:id as the decision room.
Keep Admin dispute comments under /api/admin/reviews/disputes/:disputeId/comments.
Commit dispute-source resolutions before writing operational checkpoints.
Retire the AI operator page.
Retire the Admin reverse-review history page.
acceptance: Only System Admin middleware reaches board 5.
All dispute workflow states have lanes.
The AI operator alias stays inside the System realm; Admin reverse-review page and API are absent.
Alternative dispute-source resolution completes without a transaction-lock timeout.

phases.name: Legacy and evidence cleanup
items: Remove retired URLs from navigation, dashboards, settings, and profile links.
Remove retired review/history/inbox routes; keep only explicit task/operator compatibility aliases.
Remove retired reverse-review history GET APIs and obsolete contract tests.
Replace the eight evidence artifacts.
Run targeted tests and GitNexus change detection.

verification: Unit tests for shared-prop realm shaping and retired-route absence.
Integration tests for project access and Done-to-review transaction.
Component tests for workspace switchers and five boards.
Security tests for both cross-realm directions.
